summary: Frontend-only retest of the payment-request unblock fix (Iter 208/209) in the Project Request Center UI. PRIMARY bug is FIXED: raised the user's exact screenshot case twice (Fuel Payment, HEAD-OFFICE project, HEADOFF cost center, Expense Type Fuel/Diesel, Settlement Vendor Payable, Priority High, UPI with manual payee 'rahul', Rs 5000, blank description). Both were accepted (HTTP 200, REQ-2026-0315 and REQ-2026-0316, success toast each time, no 'already raised today' warning). Same result with request type Head Office Expense (REQ-0317/0318). Every other payment type submitted fine with a description: accommodation, insurance, one_time_vehicle, vehicle_manpower, vehicle_material, other, fuel, self_expense, head_office_expense (REQ-0319..0327), all shown in the list. True duplicate is still caught: an identical accommodation request (same vendor, project, amount and description) raised 27s later got HTTP 409 and ONE 'Duplicate detected — not saved ... REQ-2026-0328' toast. The dialog stayed open and no second row was created. Workflow works: Manager Log approved REQ-0315 from Project Request Center and it moved to With Department / Accounts: Pending Verification. Accounts then saw it in the Payment Processing Center UPI Quick Pay lane and the Pending Verification tab (paid to rahul, Rs 5,000). Advance Request works when filled correctly on the first try (AD-2026-0190 submitted). However I found a NEW BLOCKING bug in the advance path (see critical): a failed first submit leaves an orphan draft, and the corrected re-submit is then refused as a 'duplicate'. All test data was deleted: 14 project_requests, 2 employee_advances, 1 approvals row.

critical.issue: The advance doc is inserted as status 'draft' BEFORE _submit_advance runs. When the submit fails validation (e.g. 400 'Reference documents are required for this approval...' because no file was attached and 'Not applicable' was not ticked), the request returns 400 but the orphan draft (AD-2026-0189) stays in the DB. The user then attaches docs / ticks N/A and clicks Submit again with the same employee, type, amount and reason. That attempt is REFUSED with HTTP 409 'Abhilash Kumar already has an identical Emergency Advance request of Rs 1,500 raised today (AD-2026-0189)'. Because the duplicate rule counts 'draft' status, this blocks advance requests in the very flow the user is complaining about. Reproduced in the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: On a 409 duplicate it shows TWO toasts: the global 'Duplicate detected' warning plus its own toast.error with the same text. ProjectRequests.jsx was fixed to skip toast.error when e.response.data.duplicate is set; Advances.jsx (and the bulk path) still double-toasts.

Manager Log (test_log@erp.com) gets 'Access Denied — You don't have approvals read permission' on /app/my-approvals, yet GET /api/my-inbox returns their 12 pending project requests. They can still approve from Project Request Center, so this is not blocking.

issues: The label reads 'DESCRIPTION / JUSTIFICATION *' (marked mandatory), but a blank description is now accepted. Either drop the asterisk or enforce it, so users are not confused.

When Paid To = Vendor (the default) and the user picks UPI plus a manual 'Any Name', the form still refuses with 'Select the approved vendor to be paid'. If the user's screenshot had Paid To left on Vendor, they would hit this frontend validation. Consider treating a UPI manual name as a valid payee whatever Paid To is set to, or auto-switching Paid To to Person when UPI Any Name is filled.

action_items: HIGH: advance_router.create_advance should run the docs-gate/submit validation BEFORE insert_one, or delete/roll back the draft when _submit_advance raises. Also consider excluding status 'draft' from the advance duplicate query, so a failed submit can never block the corrected retry.
LOW: Advances.jsx submit() and bulk submit: skip toast.error when e.response.data.duplicate is true (same as ProjectRequests.jsx).
LOW: Give manager_log (and any approver role that uses /api/my-inbox) 'approvals' read permission, or let the /app/my-approvals route through for inbox-only users.
LOW (UX): remove the '*' from Description/Justification in the Payment dialog. Accept a UPI 'Any Name' as the payee even when Paid To = Vendor.
critical_code_review_comments: advance_router.create_advance: insert-then-validate pattern leaves orphan drafts on any _submit_advance failure, which then collide with the business-key duplicate guard.
ProjectRequests.jsx is 1190+ lines and Advances.jsx is ~890 lines, both over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the Raise dialog into its own component.

project_requests duplicate guard (L547-583) matches the spec: it fires only when the description is non-empty, a payee is present, it was raised the same day and it is not yet paid. Verified in the UI.

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all payment-request scenarios passed; advance retry-after-validation-error path fails

seed_data_creation: None left behind. Created then deleted REQ-2026-0315..0328 (14 rows), AD-2026-0189 (orphan draft) and AD-2026-0190, plus 1 approvals row. Duplicate-block log entries were left at /app/admin/duplicate-blocks as evidence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI path: /app/ops/requests -> [data-testid=req-new-service] (Payment). Use req-form-type, req-form-project (option 'HEAD-OFFICE'), req-form-costcenter (HEADOFF id d456938d-295b-410a-9076-17c3ff7ca879), req-form-paidto-type=person, req-form-expense-type, req-form-settlement, the priority select (no testid; filter select by option[value=high]), req-form-payment-mode-upi, req-form-upi-any-name, req-form-amount, req-form-desc, req-form-submit. For HO/self expense types use req-form-ho-costcenter. Cost centers load async, so poll the option list. Vendor: click req-form-vendor-select then req-form-vendor-select-option-<id> (FastTrack Transporters 60788192-23ec-4561-9383-9b963295402f). Project PRJ-2026-0035 has cost centers. The submission fingerprint window is 25s; wait more than 25s before a true-duplicate retest. Advance: /app/hr/advances -> advance-new-btn, on-behalf-toggle, emp-select, type-select, amount, installments, reason, [data-testid$='-na-toggle'] + [data-testid$='-na-reason'], submit-btn. To retest the orphan-draft bug: submit an advance WITHOUT ticking N/A (expect 400), then tick N/A and submit again; it must NOT return 409.
rca of the issue: Payment request (user's report): fixed. The duplicate guard now needs both a non-empty description and a payee, so blank-description repeats pass. New advance issue: create_advance calls db.employee_advances.insert_one(status='draft') and then _submit_advance(), which raises 400 from the reference-docs gate. The HTTP error leaves the draft in place. On retry, the duplicate query (same employee, type, amount and reason, same day, status not in rejected/cancelled/closed/recovered) matches that draft and returns 409. Repro: on /app/hr/advances, open New Advance -> On behalf -> pick an employee, Emergency Advance, 1500, reason X, no docs -> Submit (400). Then tick Not applicable, add a reason -> Submit -> 409 duplicate of the orphan AD number. Fix: validate the docs before inserting, or delete the draft in a try/except around _submit_advance, and/or exclude 'draft' from the duplicate query.
